title: Live feed, client to gateway, v1
description: The one message a browser sends on the WebSocket /ws/v1: what it wants to receive. A new subscribe message replaces the previous one.

area.description: The map area to receive aircraft for. Null or absent: no aircraft.

sensors.description: True to receive the readings of all sensors.

area.description: A box in degrees. lamin must be below lamax and lomin below lomax; a box across the 180th meridian is not supported.
